title: Error Runtime, Security, and Extension
readerIntent: Register, propagate, present, and observe an outcome safely.
priorKnowledge: Know the owning capability and failure classification.
owner: Owning capability, common error primitives, status service, pipeline, and response handler
summary: Failures retain code, response classification, safe context, cause, and trace through layers; public responses expose only allowlisted fields.

sections.heading: Runtime
items: Create or propagate a registered capability-owned code.
Preserve the original cause and add bounded layer, pipeline, module, tenant, operation, and trace context.
Let the pipeline follow its error terminal and cleanup contract.
Resolve status metadata from the central catalog.
Map to a safe HTTP or transport response.
Keep stacks, paths, queries, payloads, credentials, nested causes, and protected context in server diagnostics only.

sections.heading: Extension
items: Add capability-specific codes in the owning module, not a global catch-all file.
Keep codes stable; version or deprecate semantic changes.
Separate developer diagnostics from user-facing content and localization.
Never convert unknown codes to invented success responses.
Test known/unknown code lookup, nested causes, cross-module propagation, public redaction, trace correlation, and regression.
